content: The Vice Chancellor (VC) of Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Women University (SBBWU), Peshawar is Prof. Dr. Safia Ahmad who is  the chief executive and academic head of the university. The VC is responsible for overall administration, academic policies, and implementation of university rules and regulations.

The first Vice Chancellor of Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Women University (SBBWU), Peshawar is Prof. Dr. Syeda Farhana Jahangir, who served during the early establishment period of the university (around its founding years).
Prof. Dr. Razia Sultana is  as one of the Vice Chancellors of SBBWU Peshawar after the initial founding phase, contributing to the university's administrative development during her tenure.
Prof. Dr. Noor Jehan is  Vice Chancellor of SBBWU Peshawar in the more recent administrative periods before the current leadership, playing a role in academic and institutional management.
